limitations: This is a dated audit of publicly visible official GitHub/Hugging Face, published OpenPI README/config/model files, public checkpoint prefixes, and official announcements. Absence from these endpoints is not proof that no private, access-controlled, differently named or future model exists.
GitHub search index may lag; direct README/config/directory and branch/release inspections provide additional evidence but do not audit every file on every branch.
Public GCS top-level checkpoint names are not a complete model identity map; undocumented aliases were not inferred to be pi06/pi07.
Latest API model identity, downloadable weights, local SDK/runtime requirements and 5080 memory requirements are not established by the API beta announcement.
Community ports/reimplementations and LeRobot model conversions are not treated as official Physical Intelligence releases.
No API account application, service installation, user-data upload, model allocation, GPU use, training or robot connection occurred in this availability audit.
